title: Hitler's Birthplace in Austria Reopens as Police Station
summary: The building in Braunau am Inn, Austria, where Adolf Hitler was born in 1889 has been converted into a police station. The Austrian government acquired the property in 2016 to prevent it from becoming a pilgrimage site for neo-Nazis. The renovation aimed to remove its historical association with Nazism and repurpose the space for public service. The new police station will house officers and community services.
summary_points: Adolf Hitler's birthplace in Braunau am Inn, Austria, has been reopened.
The building has been converted into a police station.
The Austrian government purchased the property in 2016.
The acquisition aimed to prevent neo-Nazi pilgrimages.
The renovation sought to repurpose the site for public service.

summary_points_hi: ऑस्ट्रिया के ब्रौनौ एम इन में एडॉल्फ हिटलर के जन्मस्थान को फिर से खोला गया है।
इमारत को पुलिस स्टेशन में बदल दिया गया है।
ऑस्ट्रियाई सरकार ने 2016 में संपत्ति खरीदी थी।
अधिग्रहण का उद्देश्य नव-नाज़ी तीर्थयात्राओं को रोकना था।
नवीनीकरण का लक्ष्य स्थल को सार्वजनिक सेवा के लिए पुन: उपयोग करना था।
